alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen. A steaming pot sits on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks to the pot in the first second, leans in to taste with a small pulse, and a speech bubble says more salt. It walks back, comes again, tastes, and the bubble says a bit more. The third time it tastes, its eyes turn happy and the bubble says perfect. Then it narrows its eyes at the camera. The text stays: me tasting the soup for the fourth time.
